values.note: 44 tent/RV sites (38 take an RV, 6 are tent-only) and 15 lean-tos in two loops. RV sites list 23-45 ft: 18 list exactly 23 ft, 20 take 25 ft or more (T39, T41 and T44 to 45 ft).

sites.source: https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/elmore ('Elmore State Park has 44 tent/RV sites and 15 lean-tos') + vtstateparks-visit.com parkId 1280075 site list (38 Campsite Tent/RV, 6 Campsite Tent Only, max equipment 23-45 ft), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: vtstateparks-visit.com parkId 1280075 (campsites typed 'Campsite Tent/RV' / 'Tent Only'; only the pavilion and meeting room are electric) + https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/elmore (no hookups among the facilities), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/elmore ('2 campground bathrooms with flush toilets, hot and cold running water and token-operated showers') + 2026 Map & Guide (RV Sanitary Station symbol inside the Loop B campground, drinking-water taps), read 2026-11-16

note: Wooded campground about 400 m uphill from Lake Elmore's day-use beach, which has a CCC-built beach house, a concession and boat rentals. Trails climb Elmore Mountain to a fire tower. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA site list + 2026 map: 44 tent/RV (38 RV-capable), all RV sites 23 ft+ (18 at exactly 23, max 45); no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump (map), water. Fees $20/$38 confirmed. Manual season 05-22/10-14 has the wrong closing day - flag (10-12 in 2026, 10-11 in 2027). Not waterfront confirmed; the stored note ('sites near the lake shore') was wrong and is replaced. Phone absent -> 802-888-2982. Pin at the VT 12 entrance ~270 m east of the loops: move recommended. Website .html -> /parks/elmore.
flags: SEASON (manual, not overwritten): stored closes 10-14 is wrong. The page: 'Friday of Memorial Day Weekend through the second Monday in October.' = May 22 - Oct 12 in 2026, May 28 - Oct 11 in 2027 (booking site: 'Closed through Thu May 27 2027'). Stored opens 05-22 is right. Reviewer: change closes to 10-12.
WEBSITE: stored https://www.vtstateparks.com/elmore.html -> https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/elmore (200, this park); keep the RA link.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, confirmed): the 2026 Map & Guide draws the campground as a separate area from the Day Use Area beach; Esri imagery shows the loops in woods ~400 m north-west of the beach (beach ~44.5416,-72.5286). No campsite is tagged 'Near Water'. The old note 'Campground on Lake Elmore with sites near the lake shore and beach area' contradicted this and is replaced.

PIN MOVE: stored 44.5445,-72.5278 is on VT 12 at the park entrance road. The loops (teardrop Loop A, oval Loop B, contact station at their south-east corner) are centred near ~44.5446,-72.5312 on Esri imagery. Recommend ~44.5446,-72.5312, ~270 m from the stored pin.

SITE LENGTHS: 18 of 38 RV sites list exactly 23 ft. The other sites vary (25, 28, 30, 34, 45), so it reads as a measured value rather than a uniform placeholder, but those 18 are a tight fit for a 23-ft rig; 20 sites take 25 ft or more.

ALERTS: Fire Tower closed Sept 14-Oct 30 and trailhead parking closed Sept 29-30 for repairs (2026, past); day-use concessions and boat rentals 'may be delayed or unavailable'. Nothing affecting campground access.

INCLUSION EVIDENCE: says 'accommodates RVs up to 50 ft'; the booking site's longest is 45 ft. Same campground; suggested replacement: 'vtstateparks.com Elmore: 44 tent/RV sites + 15 lean-tos, dump station; booking site lists 38 RV-capable sites at 23-45 ft -> real drive-in RV campground'.
